rationale: Motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and policyholder injuries from impact.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan was rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 am by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking, resulting in a totaled vehicle (trunk crushed). Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's information documented on police report. High-priority due to vehicle total loss and injury assessment needed.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling 35 mph without braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; trunk crushed into back seat
